procedure_text: 在装有搅拌器,温度计和回流冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中加入2-氯甲苯25.3g(0.2mol)、无水三氯化铝40.5g(0.3mol)和1,2-二氯乙烷150ml,冷却至5℃,然后滴加甲磺酰氯25.25g(0.22mol),滴加温度不超过10℃,滴加完毕,升至室温继续反应10h,LC跟踪（液相色谱）至反应完全,将反应物倾入冰水中,分出有机层,水层用1,2-二氯甲烷萃取,合并有机相,浓缩得淡黄的固体28.6g,收率84％。
procedure_summary: The chlorotoluene starting material is sulfonylated with methanesulfonyl chloride and anhydrous aluminium trichloride in dichloroethane, the sulfonyl chloride being added dropwise under cooling and the mixture then held at room temperature until liquid chromatography shows complete conversion. The mixture is quenched into ice water, the aqueous layer back-extracted, and the combined organic phases concentrated to a pale yellow solid.
notes: Chinese heading 1、2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成 (synthesis of 2-chloro-6-methanesulfonyltoluene). Reactor is a 500 ml four-necked flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a reflux condenser; the stirrer type is not stated, so stirring.type is left null. TEMPERATURE CONVENTION used throughout this section: where the step states a numeric temperature it is recorded in the structured field and the remaining stages are written out here; time_h is the stated reaction hold time. Here the charge is cooled to 5 C, the methanesulfonyl chloride is added dropwise with the addition temperature kept below 10 C (recorded in that compound's addition_profile), and the mixture is then warmed to room temperature and held for 10 h, which is the time recorded. ARITHMETIC: the three printed mass/mole pairs of this step are all self-consistent (2-chlorotoluene 25.3 g/0.2 mol implies 126.5 against 126.59; methanesulfonyl chloride 25.25 g/0.22 mol implies 114.77 against 114.55; aluminium trichloride 40.5 g/0.3 mol implies 135.0 against 133.34, within about 1.2%), so molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised here. The product figures do not close: 0.2 mol at 204.67 gives 40.93 g theoretical, of which 84% is 34.38 g, but 28.6 g is printed, which is 69.9% of theory. The printed mass and yield close only against a molecular weight of 170.2, which is the molecular weight of the des-chloro analogue 6-methanesulfonyltoluene (170.23) and is exactly the value step 2 charges for this same compound. Recorded as printed and not corrected. EXTRACTION SOLVENT: the Chinese prints 1,2-二氯甲烷 for the back-extraction, which is not a valid compound name (the reaction solvent is 1,2-二氯乙烷 and later steps use 二氯甲烷); the A1 identifier is kept verbatim and unresolved rather than repaired. DRAWING: the structure drawn at line 185 (C8H9ClO2S) matches the product named in the heading, so no drawing conflict; note that the drawn structure carries the ring chlorine that the printed arithmetic omits.

THIS IS THE STEP WHOSE MASS CANNOT BE RECONCILED WITH ITS OWN STATED YIELD ON ANY READING. mass_balance_implausible: 0.24 mol of substrate at a product molecular weight of 248.68 gives 59.68 g theoretical, of which 72% is 42.97 g, but 82 g is printed. 82 g is 137% of the theoretical maximum, so the printed mass exceeds what the printed input moles could give even at complete conversion; the mass and yield together imply a molecular weight of 474.5, which corresponds to no species in this reaction. Sodium hypochlorite is recorded as 500 g of solution as printed, not as contained hypochlorite. Numbers recorded exactly as printed and not corrected. procedure_summary: The side-chain methyl group of the benzoate ester is brominated with elemental bromine in carbon tetrachloride using peroxybenzoic acid as the radical initiator, the bromine being added dropwise at room temperature before the mixture is heated at reflux. The cooled mixture is neutralised with saturated sodium bicarbonate, the organic layer washed with water and concentrated, and the crude solid washed with ethyl acetate and dried.
notes: Chinese heading 5、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯. Reactor is a 500 ml four-necked flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser; stirrer type not stated. Mechanism is radical on the strength of the peroxide initiator with bromine at reflux. NAMED REACTION CAVEAT: recorded as Wohl-Ziegler bromination because it is a radical benzylic bromination of exactly that type, but the patent deliberately uses elemental bromine with a peroxybenzoic acid initiator in place of NBS, which paragraph [0031] presents as one of the invention's cost improvements; a strict reading of Wohl-Ziegler requires NBS. molar_mass_inconsistent, two separate pairs in this step: the substrate charge 43.6 g / 0.2 mol implies 218.0 against the true 262.71 for C10H11ClO4S, a shortfall of 44.71 that is larger than a chlorine-for-hydrogen substitution and does not match the des-chloro methyl ester (228.26) either; and the bromine charge 39.6 g / 0.22 mol implies 180.0 against 159.81 for Br2, an over-statement of 12.6%. mass_balance_implausible: 0.2 mol at a product molecular weight of 341.60 gives 68.32 g theoretical, of which 70% is 47.82 g, but 41.6 g is printed, which is 60.9% of theory; mass and yield close only against a molecular weight of 297.1, which also disagrees with the 279.0 step 6 charges for this same compound. scale_discontinuity is NOT raised: 43.6 g charged against the 44.2 g step 4 reports isolating is a subset and therefore possible. The structure drawn at line 225 (C10H10BrClO4S) matches the product named in the heading.

procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide is displaced by sodium trifluoroethoxide in tetrahydrofuran at room temperature to give the trifluoroethyl ether, which is carried on without isolation and saponified with aqueous sodium hydroxide at reflux. The solvent is distilled off, the residue acidified with hydrochloric acid, extracted with dichloromethane, washed with water, dried over magnesium sulfate and concentrated to a white solid.
notes: Chinese heading 6、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成. THIS IS THE FIRST OF THE TWO ONE-POT STEPS. One numbered step, two sequential transformations in the same flask: etherification of the benzylic bromide with sodium trifluoroethoxide (room temperature, 16 h), then hydrolysis of the ester with sodium hydroxide and water at reflux (4 h). The intermediate is only water-washed and concentrated between the two, never isolated or purified and never assigned an amount, so the step is kept as one record. reaction_class follows the FINAL transformation and is therefore hydrolysis; named_reaction records Williamson ether synthesis, which names the first transformation, because the saponification carries no canonical name. Conditions likewise follow the final transformation: temperature room_temperature is the stated value for the first stage, heating_method reflux and time_h 4.0 belong to the hydrolysis; the first stage's 16 h room-temperature hold is stated here rather than in time_h. Reactor is a 500 ml four-necked flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser; stirrer type not stated. NAMING INCONSISTENCY INTERNAL TO THE PATENT: the step charges the methyl ester (甲酯) but names the in-situ intermediate the ethyl ester (乙酯); no ethyl group is introduced anywhere in the step. Recorded with the A1 identifier as printed and not corrected. No structure is drawn for that intermediate. molar_mass_inconsistent: the substrate charge 55.8 g / 0.2 mol implies 279.0 against the true 341.60 for C10H10BrClO4S, a shortfall of 62.6. The sodium trifluoroethoxide (122.17 against 122.02) and sodium hydroxide (40.0 against 40.00) pairs are both correct, so the defect is specific to the aromatic substrate. mass_balance_implausible: 0.2 mol at a product molecular weight of 346.70 gives 69.34 g theoretical, of which 92% is 63.79 g, but 55.6 g is printed, which is 80.2% of theory; mass and yield close against a molecular weight of 302.2, which is exactly what step 7 charges for this compound, so the patent is internally consistent here but consistently wrong against the drawn structure. scale_discontinuity: this step charges 55.8 g of a material of which step 5 isolated only 41.6 g. The NMR data sit inside the same paragraph [0054] as the procedure and are therefore kept in the verbatim procedure_text. The structure drawn at line 234 (C11H10ClF3O5S) matches the product named in the heading.

The Chinese prints 氯化亚砜71.4(0.6mol) with no mass unit; recorded as grams in line with every other charge in the section and flagged in A1's compound note rather than corrected here. The solvent is distilled off, water and hydrochloric acid are added, and the product is extracted with ethyl acetate, washed, dried over anhydrous magnesium sulfate and concentrated to a beige solid.
notes: Chinese heading 8、环磺草酮的合成 (synthesis of tembotrione), the final step of the section.
